details: Grayscale launched its Zcash Spot ETF (ZCSH) on NYSE Arca on August 25, 2026, marking the first US-listed exchange-traded product dedicated solely to ZEC. ZEC surged post-launch, nearing an eight-year high, as the ETF converts Grayscale's existing Zcash Trust to offer investors spot exposure through traditional brokerage accounts.
title: Grayscale's Zcash ETF Begins Trading on NYSE Arca

details: Bitcoin is hovering above $78,000, struggling to break past $80,000 after its strongest weekly rise in three years. BTC ETFs recorded their seventh consecutive day of inflows, totaling $314 million on Tuesday. BlackRock's tax-deferred Bitcoin-to-ETF swaps reached $5 billion, signaling strengthening institutional demand despite the price consolidation.
title: Bitcoin Stalls Near $80K Amid Strong ETF Inflows

details: Altcoins have seen a significant surge in trading activity, with their volume dominance reaching an unprecedented 65% on Binance. This shift, following Bitcoin's recent rally, suggests a broader resurgence of risk appetite in the market, with the altcoin market capitalization climbing by approximately $135 billion.
title: Altcoin Volume Dominance Hits Two-Year High

details: Circle minted approximately 5 billion USDC in the past week, marking one of its largest weekly issuance pushes this year. This surge in supply, alongside Circle becoming the technical deployer for Hyperliquid's $5 billion USDC reserve, indicates strong demand for dollar-backed stablecoins and increased liquidity potentially entering crypto markets.
title: Circle Mints 5 Billion USDC in a Week
